Support The Flip

Donate

The Flip is a volunteer-run nonprofit. Your donation keeps vintage machines playable, funds repairs and restorations, and helps us advance our mission.

Make a Donation

We'll use your support to purchase parts, create exhibits, and otherwise advance our mission by making pinball's history available to everyone.

Donate Now

Other Ways to Help

  • Become a sponsor — businesses and organizations can support the museum and be recognized on our sponsors page.
  • Lend machines and exhibits — have a pinball machine, parts, or memorabilia? Get in touch.
  • Volunteer — help with repairs, events, and running the museum.

The Flip NFP is an Illinois Not-For-Profit Corporation and an IRS-registered 501(c)(3), EIN 39-2820678. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. Payments are processed securely by Square, which emails your receipt.
